sampling.development: original60 plus SHA256 ranks361-960, fixed600 additional companies, no outcome selection
sampling.holdout: SHA256 rank241-360, all120, not previously selected

definitions.target: Sum of FN146+FN147+FN148 TTM cashflow-reconciliation contributions, signed CNY; not classified valuation working capital
definitions.repeat_latest: predict next TTM equals latest TTM
definitions.zero_forecast: explicit forecast of no net contribution, never a replacement for missing actuals
definitions.inventory_intensity_half: 0.5 * (current H1 net inventory FN17 - prior H1 net inventory FN17 * current TTM revenue / prior H1 TTM revenue). Predicts inventory cash adjustment statistically; receivable/payable contributions explicitly forecast zero. Not an accounting equality or a forecast of reported inventory stock.

source_rules: quarterly revenue FN230; cumulative FN146/147/148 annual + H1 - previous H1, all three source-period components must be present/nonzero; source zero ambiguous, signed aggregate zero allowed; reject missing/duplicate/nonfinite/late; losses included; FN17 instant CNY, both same-season H1 balances positive; prior H1 revenue positive and all source inputs available at current forecast cutoff; common driver-admitted cohort for baseline/benchmark/candidate
discipline: Development only before selection freeze; same ranks241-360 holdout as capex study, never scored in that study; require passing reproducible development receipt before holdout; no outcome-driven company replacement
boundary: Later-acquired TDX+FN314 research timing, not strict PIT, standard facts, classified WC or FCFF; current listed industry universe survivor bias; no production policy change

driver_policy.minimum_inventory: positive at both H1 dates; ambiguous zero refused
driver_policy.scope: FN17 net stock is a predictor only; target remains actual FN146+FN147+FN148. Gross stock/provision movements are not imputed. Difference from working capital or FCFF classification remains explicit.

research_reason: The original60 span26 industries (max11 companies); expand development deterministically before extra outcomes are scored, keep v2 formula/gates unchanged and the original120 holdout unopened. Expansion is development, not an independent validation claim. Report original60/new600 separately as well as combined.
